messages.subject: gmcm   model :   itemfit()  function error
parts:
Hi Phil;  

First of all thank you very much for creating this wonderful   mirt   package.    I have come across one issue with the  itemfit()  function.  It seems that it is giving   some error with the “gpcm” model.  I am using data set having three categories and there are missing values in the data set.  

    

re_fit_gpcm= mirt(my_data_poly,1, itemtype ="gpcm", TOL=tol,SE=TRUE)

Theta = fscores(re_fit_gpcm, method = "ML", full.scores=TRUE)

fit_stat_gpcm=itemfit(re_fit_gpcm,impute =1, Theta=Theta)

I am using the  mirt version 1.9 …..  As u can see I am passing   the Theta,  estimate  as I have missing values.   I am getting the following error

Error in makeObstables(dat, x@K) :

  NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments

 

But  this will work  for the dichotomous data with missing values and  any dichotomous model(1,2,3
pl    moldels) .  It will  be great  help If you can give me some idea on this or suggest something so that I can fix it. !!!!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: gmcm model : itemfit() function error
parts:
Hi Briti,

I think this issue has largely been patched on the development version (point estimates of Theta are no longer required, which is the main issue here). I'd recommend installing the dev version and reporting back if you run into other problems (https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt). Cheers.

Phil
